units_note: macro-F1, recall, accuracy, rates, priors, Jaccard, OOV and shares in percent (differences in pp); Q, error correlation, disagreement, AUROC, NLL, thresholds and weights raw. Cells: mean/SD (ddof=1) over seeds x folds, sd_seed = SD of the per-seed means.
oracle_note: every key starting with oracle_ is fitted in-sample on the TARGET labels (analysis only)
comparator_note: 'Best single (val-selected)' (best_single_rule) picks the learner per (seed, fold) on that fold's validation split: the submission's comparator, used in domain and under shift. best_val_learner is one global learner per direction chosen on the pooled validation splits of all its units: a hindsight baseline for transfer-side rankings; its in-domain values are partly selected with test labels (other folds' validation splits overlap each fold's test portion) and are reference only.

bootstrap.note: replicates resample the target instances (shared by every fold model, rule and seed, and by the directions whose targets are the same posts) and the seeds (shared by the directions of one source); a seed's value is the mean over its fold models; percentile CIs, two-sided p_boot without multiplicity correction

summary.note: transfer entries are summarised over the directions and in-domain entries over the sources; n_directions_* counts compare each direction's transfer value with its own source's in-domain value

diversity.basis: Q and error_corr measure how dependent the learners' errors are; disagreement and the contested share also rise when accuracy falls (see disagreement_implied_by_accuracy)

dependence.note: directions of one source share its fold models; directions whose targets are the same posts share the target instances; EV-Norm and EV-Raw are the same 1,382 posts in two renderings

g_lexical.tokenisation: lower-cased [a-z0-9]+ tokens; source vocabulary = all texts of the source corpus
g_lexical.affix_rule: token longer than 5 with prefix mem-/men- or suffix -kan, or longer than 4 with suffix -nya
g_lexical.near_dup_rule: share of target texts whose token set has Jaccard >= 0.5 (0.8) with some source text
